title: HueDeck controllable parameters (plugin user-control descriptors)
description: The array returned by a device plugin's ControllableParameters() export, and the object shape accepted by device.addProperty()/getProperty(). Each entry becomes a module-level global named <property> inside the plugin and an on<property>Changed() hook is invoked before the next Render() when the user changes it. Plugins frequently write numeric and boolean fields as strings ("min":"100", "default":"false"); the engine coerces them, so every numeric field here accepts number|string. Corpus facts (SignalRGB 2.5.80, ~4000 descriptors): device plugins only use color, combobox, number, boolean and keycode; values are string[] or mixed number/string arrays; min/max/step are almost always quoted; live is only ever false. Macro scripts (this.Options) use the same descriptor shape, add mousecode and {key,label} values, and additionally use the macro-only types effectname, layoutname, effectpreset, device, playlist and sensor, which are deliberately NOT in this enum (they are validated by the macros subsystem).

numberish.description: A number, or a string that parses as one (plugins commonly quote numbers).

booleanish.description: A boolean, or one of the string/number spellings plugins use for it.

property.description: JS identifier of the global the value is exposed as; also the persistence key.

label.description: UI label. Defaults to property when absent.

type.description: Widget/value type. color -> "#RRGGBB" string; combobox/list -> one of values (stored by key); number -> number; boolean -> boolean; hue -> number 0..360; textfield -> string (optionally constrained by filter); keycode -> key-name string ("None" sentinel); mousecode -> mouse-button name ("None" sentinel). list is accepted as an alias of combobox.

group.description: UI grouping key (e.g. "lighting", "settings", "dpi"). May be empty.

min.description: Lower bound for number/hue (for color: hue range lower bound, conventionally 0).

max.description: Upper bound for number/hue (for color: conventionally 360).

default.description: Initial value. Type depends on type; plugins often quote numbers and booleans.

values.description: Choices for combobox/list: plain strings, numbers, or {key,label} objects.

live.description: true (default): apply as the user drags/edits; false: apply only on explicit save.

order.description: Sort index inside the group (lower first).
